data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (Cars tab, pick-up, drop-off if different, dates and times, Search, then filters and sort) and has nearly the same parameters. Its weaknesses are that it leaves sort out of the parameters and describes the filters and sort only loosely, and the observed actions show a sort-by selection (Total Price) with no clear filter selections.
